test_title: PYST 56: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 13th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Arya borrowed some money at the rate of 5% per annum for the first 3 years, at the rate of 8% per annum for the next 4 years, and at the rate of 16% per annum for the period beyond seven years. If he pays a total interest of Rs. 15,730 at the end of 13 years, then how much money did he borrow?
solution:
Formula:

SI = (P x R x T) / 100

Effective interest rate = T × R

Where, P = Principal amount, R = Rate, T = Time

Calculation :

Let the principal be 100.

According to the question-

⇒ 5% p.a. for 3 years

∴ Effective rate for 3 year period = 5 × 3 = 15%

⇒ 8% p.a. for 4 years

∴ Effective rate for 4 year period = 8 × 4 = 32%

Remaining time = 13 - (3 + 4) = 6 years

⇒ 16% p.a. for 6 years

∴ Effective rate for the remaining 6 year period = 6 × 16 = 96%

Collective effective tax rate for 13 year period = 15% + 32% + 96% = 143%

∴ SI = (100 x 143 x 1) / 100 = 143

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58524b432668013b1719f23d0b23cd2cfd4748965b5ff4f47844aedb734a1a45.png] 

⇒ x = 15,730 × 100over143 = Rs 11,000

∴ The money borrowed is Rs 11,000.
